name: Select Cluster
func:
msg.topic = `SELECT 
    CASE
        WHEN cluster_profile = 0 THEN 'Regular AC Charging'
        WHEN cluster_profile = 1 THEN 'Top-Ups'
        WHEN cluster_profile = 2 THEN 'Fast Charging'
        WHEN cluster_profile = 3 THEN 'Medium Power DC Charging'
        ELSE 'Desconhecido'
    END AS label,
    COUNT(*) AS value
FROM ev_stations
WHERE cluster_profile IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY cluster_profile
ORDER BY label;`

return msg;

name: Select DotW
func:
msg.topic = `SELECT 
    day_of_week AS series, 
    COUNT(*) AS data        
FROM charging
GROUP BY day_of_week
ORDER BY FIELD(day_of_week, 'Monday', 'Tuesday', 'Wednesday', 'Thursday', 'Friday', 'Saturday', 'Sunday');`

return msg;

name: Cluster Info
func:
msg.topic = `SELECT 
    cluster_profile,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.station_id) AS 'Total Estações',
    ROUND(AVG(c.energy_consumed), 2) AS 'Energia Média (kWh)',
    ROUND(AVG(c.duration), 2) AS 'Duração Média (h)'
FROM 
    ev_stations s
JOIN 
    charging c ON s.station_id = c.station_id
WHERE 
    s.cluster_profile IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 
    s.cluster_profile
ORDER BY 
    cluster_profile;`

return msg;

name: Select TotD
func:
msg.topic = `SELECT 
    time_of_day AS label, 
    COUNT(*) AS value
FROM charging
GROUP BY time_of_day
ORDER BY FIELD(time_of_day, 'Morning', 'Afternoon', 'Evening', 'Night');`

return msg;

name: Select Vehicle
func:
msg.topic = `SELECT 
    vehicle_model AS label, 
    COUNT(*) AS value
FROM charging
GROUP BY vehicle_model
ORDER BY value DESC
LIMIT 5;`

return msg;

name: Select Station
func:
msg.topic = `SELECT 
    station_id AS label, 
    SUM(cost) AS value
FROM charging
GROUP BY station_id
ORDER BY value DESC
LIMIT 5;`

return msg;

name: Select SoC
func:
msg.topic = `SELECT 
    CASE
        WHEN state_of_charge_start < 20 THEN 'Low (<20%)'
        WHEN state_of_charge_start BETWEEN 20 AND 60 THEN 'Normal (20-60%)'
        WHEN state_of_charge_start > 60 THEN 'High (>60%)'
    END AS label,
    COUNT(*) AS value
FROM charging
WHERE state_of_charge_start IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY label;`

return msg;

name: Select KPI's
func:
msg.topic = `SELECT 
    SUM(energy_consumed) as total_energy,
    SUM(cost) as total_revenue,
    AVG(vehicle_age) as avg_age
FROM charging;`

return msg;

name: Format KPI's
Select Stations
func:
msg.topic = `SELECT 
    charging.session_id AS 'ID',
    charging.station_id AS 'Station',
    charging.vehicle_model AS 'Vehicle',
    charging.energy_consumed AS 'Energy',      
    charging.cost AS 'Cost',                   
    charging.duration AS 'Duration',           
    DATE_FORMAT(charging.start_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS 'Start_Time',
    charging.state_of_charge_start AS 'SOC_Start',
    charging.state_of_charge_end AS 'SOC_End',
    ev_stations.cluster_profile AS 'Cluster'
FROM charging
JOIN ev_stations ON charging.station_id = ev_stations.station_id
ORDER BY charging.session_id DESC
LIMIT 1000;`;

return msg;

name: Format Table
Cluster Info 2
func:
msg.topic = `SELECT 
    session_profile, 
    ROUND(AVG(state_of_charge_start), 1) as 'Initial SOC',
    ROUND(AVG(state_of_charge_end - state_of_charge_start), 1) as 'Charged (%)',
    ROUND(AVG(duration), 1) as 'Duration (h)'
FROM charging
WHERE session_profile IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY session_profile;`

return msg;

name: Select Cluster 2
func:
msg.topic = `SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN session_profile = 1 THEN 'Full Charge (>50% added)'
        WHEN session_profile = 2 THEN 'Quick Top-up' 
        WHEN session_profile = 0 THEN 'Long Duration / Parking'
        ELSE 'Unknown'
    END AS series,
    COUNT(*) AS data
FROM charging
WHERE session_profile IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY session_profile
ORDER BY series;`

return msg;

name: Cluster Info 3
func:
msg.topic = `SELECT 
    time_profile AS Cluster,
    ROUND(AVG(pct_morning)*100,0) as Manha,
    ROUND(AVG(pct_afternoon)*100,0) as Tarde,
    ROUND(AVG(pct_evening)*100,0) as Noite,
    ROUND(AVG(pct_night)*100,0) as Madrugada
FROM (
    SELECT 
        c.station_id,
        s.time_profile,
        SUM(CASE WHEN c.time_of_day = 'Morning' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) as pct_morning,
        SUM(CASE WHEN c.time_of_day = 'Afternoon' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) as pct_afternoon,
        SUM(CASE WHEN c.time_of_day = 'Evening' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) as pct_evening,
        SUM(CASE WHEN c.time_of_day = 'Night' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) as pct_night
    FROM charging c  -- Definimos que 'charging' agora é 'c'
    JOIN ev_stations s ON c.station_id = s.station_id -- Definimos que 'ev_stations' é 's'
    WHERE s.time_profile IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY c.station_id
) as stats
GROUP BY time_profile;`

return msg;

name: Select Cluster 3
func:
msg.topic = `SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN time_profile = 0 THEN 'Morning (Work/Commute)'  
        WHEN time_profile = 2 THEN 'Afternoon (Daytime)'     
        WHEN time_profile = 1 THEN 'Night / Overnight'      
        ELSE 'Unknown'
    END AS series,
    COUNT(*) AS data
FROM ev_stations
WHERE time_profile IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY time_profile
ORDER BY series;`

return msg;
